clue.text: Film maker, note, going round empty cinema

indicators.note: the note's letters encircle the next piece, so this signals a container

parts.note: a minim is a musical note, a half note

indicators.note: an empty word keeps only its outer shell, losing everything inside

explanation.surface: A musical note somehow orbits a deserted picture house in a film producer's story.
explanation.walkthrough: 'empty' leaves CA, the first and last letters of cinema, and 'going round' puts MINIM around it.
explanation.definitionFit: A tiny video camera is a device that makes films, so a film maker in the literal sense.

clue.text: Seaman I introduced to young Silas

parts.note: Master is the title for a boy, as in Master Smith

indicators.note: the letter is brought into the middle of another word

parts.note: Silas Marner is the weaver in George Eliot's novel

explanation.surface: A sailor is presented to a boy called Silas.
explanation.walkthrough: 'introduced to' puts I inside MARNER; MASTER is the old title for a boy.
explanation.definitionFit: A master mariner is a ship's captain qualified to command a merchant vessel.

clue.text: Confusion with no students securing place

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: holding something fast inside, so the students' letters enclose the place

parts.note: NUS is the National Union of Students

explanation.surface: Bewilderment arises when no students have a room.
explanation.walkthrough: 'securing' places PL inside NUS, after NO.
explanation.definitionFit: Nonplus as a noun is a state of perplexity in which one cannot act.

clue.text: Nail hit hard

definitions.meaning: a ... nail is a short broad-headed nail
to strike forcefully, a heavy blow

explanation.surface: Drive the nail home with a heavy blow.
explanation.definitionFit: A clout is a type of nail and also a hard blow with the hand.

clue.text: Building, foreign one, put up in very little time

indicators.note: placed inside the other word

parts.note: a moment is a very brief time

indicators.note: in a down clue, putting up a word means writing it upwards, so backwards

parts.note: un is French for one

explanation.surface: A building for a foreign company is erected in no time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'put up' turns UN into NU, which 'in' puts inside MOMENT.
explanation.definitionFit: A monument is a commemorative structure or notable building.

clue.text: Back is clutched by old bird in dance

indicators.note: one piece held inside another, as if gripped in its claws

parts.note: the dodo is an extinct bird

indicators.note: read the word is backwards

explanation.surface: An extinct bird grips something as it dances backwards.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Back' turns IS into SI, which 'clutched by' places inside DODO.
explanation.definitionFit: A do-si-do is a figure in square dancing where partners circle back to back.

clue.text: Fish woman brought to party

parts.note: Dora is a woman's name
a do is a party

explanation.surface: A woman is taken along to a party where fish is served.
explanation.definitionFit: A dorado is a large tropical fish, also called the dolphinfish or mahi-mahi.

clue.text: University taking part in investigation into marine creature

indicators.note: the letter becomes part of the word, set inside it

parts.note: a search is an investigation
in is a short form of into

explanation.surface: A university joins an inquiry into a sea creature.
explanation.walkthrough: 'taking part in' puts U inside SEARCH, followed by IN.
explanation.definitionFit: A sea urchin is a spiny marine invertebrate, an echinoderm.

clue.text: Tramp, perhaps, is a kind of boat

definitions.meaning: a vagrant who wanders about aimlessly, one example of a wanderer
a fishing boat using drift nets

explanation.surface: A tramp steamer is one sort of boat.
explanation.definitionFit: A drifter is a person who wanders without settling, and a fishing vessel using drift nets.

clue.text: Evening drink, a daily depressing experience?

definitions.meaning: a drink taken at sunset, a colonial-era term
read whimsically, the sun goes down every day, so something that brings the sun down

explanation.surface: A gloomy daily routine is relieved by a cocktail at dusk.
explanation.definitionFit: A sundowner is an alcoholic drink taken at sunset; the second sense plays on the sun going down.

clue.text: Making copy of silver-coated brooch

indicators.note: the silver letters wrap round the brooch like plating on jewellery

parts.note: Ag is the chemical symbol for silver
a pin is a brooch

explanation.surface: A jeweller copies a silver-plated brooch.
explanation.definitionFit: Aping means imitating, as an ape mimics people.

clue.text: Micro-organism affected salesmen, following a viral illness

parts.note: a germ is a micro-organism

indicators.note: letters affected or disturbed are rearranged

explanation.surface: A germ has infected salesmen, following a viral outbreak.
explanation.walkthrough: 'affected' rearranges A and SALESMEN into ANMEASLES, after GERM.
explanation.definitionFit: German measles, or rubella, is a contagious viral disease.

clue.text: English class put on extremely adept display

parts.note: CL is an abbreviation for class

indicators.note: taking only the extremes of the word, its first and last letters

explanation.surface: An English lesson stages a showing of very skilled work.
explanation.walkthrough: 'extremely' takes AT, the first and last letters of adept.
explanation.definitionFit: Eclat is a brilliant show of success or showy display.

clue.text: Overseer of exam rated room unsatisfactory

indicators.note: letters in an unsatisfactory state need putting right, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: An examiner finds the room where the exam was held poor.
explanation.definitionFit: A moderator checks examination marking for consistency, overseeing the exam process.

clue.text: Wasted time on young female writer

indicators.note: in an across clue, one piece set on another comes after it, so the time goes last

parts.note: a miss is a girl or young woman
a pen is a writing instrument

explanation.surface: A young woman author squandered her time.
explanation.definitionFit: Misspent youth or money has been squandered, used wastefully.

clue.text: Shopper put tea in bag, right?

indicators.note: placed inside the other word

parts.note: a purse is a small bag for money
cha is a slang word for tea

explanation.surface: A shopper asks whether to put tea in the bag.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts CHA inside PURSE, then R follows.
explanation.definitionFit: A purchaser is someone who buys, a shopper.

clue.text: Bit of stomach or eating disorder

indicators.note: only a part of these words is taken, a run of letters inside them

explanation.surface: Part of the stomach, or an eating disorder, is the problem.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bit of' points to the letters inside stomaCH OR EAting.
explanation.definitionFit: Chorea is a nervous disorder causing jerky involuntary movements, such as St Vitus's dance.

clue.text: Cancellation of debt immediately announced

indicators.note: spoken aloud, so what is heard sounds like another phrase

parts.note: right off means at once

explanation.surface: A debt is cancelled the instant it is declared.
explanation.walkthrough: RIGHT OFF is said aloud and heard as the entry.
explanation.definitionFit: A write-off is the cancellation of a bad debt from the accounts.

clue.text: Idolise an American hero

definitions.meaning: to idolise is to venerate or worship
Paul ... made the famous midnight ride warning of British troops in 1775

explanation.surface: Worship a celebrated patriot from the United States.
explanation.definitionFit: To revere is to hold in deep respect; Paul Revere is a hero of the American Revolution.

clue.text: There's a lot to be said for being this

definitions.text: There's a lot to be said for being this

parts.words: There's a lot to be said for being this
parts.note: the idiom 'a lot to be said for' means merit, but literally it means using many words

explanation.surface: A quality has much merit.
explanation.definitionFit: Verbose means using more words than needed, wordy.

clue.text: Books penned by Greene, perhaps, in English town

indicators.note: enclosed as if in a pen, so held inside

parts.note: Graham Greene the novelist; 'perhaps' because Graham is one of many people's names
NT is the New Testament, a set of books of the Bible

explanation.surface: Novels written by Graham Greene are set in a provincial English town.
explanation.walkthrough: 'penned by' puts NT inside GRAHAM. GRANTHAM is a market town in Lincolnshire.
explanation.definitionFit: Grantham is a town in Lincolnshire, England, birthplace of Margaret Thatcher.

clue.text: Prisoner with tracking device sewn into stockings

indicators.note: stitched inside the fabric, so placed within

parts.note: hose is a collective word for stockings
an electronic tag tracks offenders

explanation.surface: A prisoner has an electronic tag hidden in hosiery.
explanation.definitionFit: A hostage is a person held captive as security, a prisoner.

clue.text: Van male used in prank

indicators.note: put to use inside another word

parts.note: a caper is a prank or escapade

explanation.surface: A van is involved in a man's practical joke.
explanation.definitionFit: A camper is a camper van, a vehicle equipped for living in.

clue.text: Point out another way?

parts.note: a compass point, read as a direction one might point: an alternative bearing between two cardinal directions

explanation.surface: Someone asks how to indicate a different route.
explanation.definitionFit: North-east is a compass point, one of the intermediate directions on the compass.

clue.text: Catlike creature found in hollow

definitions.meaning: a carnivorous mammal of Madagascar resembling a cat
in anatomy a shallow depression or pit in a bone

explanation.surface: A cat-like animal is discovered in a cavity.
explanation.definitionFit: The fossa is a Madagascan predator, and fossa is also the anatomical term for a depression or hollow.

clue.text: Present confident manner?

definitions.meaning: to ... a show is to present it
an outward show of confidence, perhaps a pretence

explanation.surface: Display a self-assured air.
explanation.definitionFit: To front a programme is to present it; a front is a bold outward manner.

clue.text: Shows enthusiastic support for a Wesker play

definitions.meaning: Arnold Wesker's 1959 play about a Norfolk family

explanation.surface: Fans cheer loudly for a play by Arnold Wesker.
explanation.definitionFit: To root for is to cheer on, and Roots is a play by the British dramatist Arnold Wesker.

clue.text: Shooting stars a feature of this event?

definitions.text: Shooting stars a feature of this event?

parts.words: Shooting stars a feature of this event?
parts.note: not meteors but celebrities being photographed, shooting meaning taking pictures

explanation.surface: Meteors seem to be the highlight of some astronomical occasion.
explanation.definitionFit: A photocall is an arranged occasion where famous people pose to be photographed.

clue.text: Carrier is more exposed, by the sound of it

indicators.note: the word is heard rather than read, so it is a homophone

parts.note: barer means more naked or uncovered

explanation.surface: A porter is wearing fewer clothes, it seems.
explanation.walkthrough: BARER is said aloud and heard as the entry.
explanation.definitionFit: A bearer is someone who carries something, such as a coffin or a message.

clue.text: Stiffens after exercising half-heartedly, aiming for this?

definitions.text: Stiffens after exercising half-heartedly, aiming for this?

indicators.note: letters put through exercise are moved about, signalling rearrangement
the heart of the word is its central double F, and half of that pair goes

explanation.surface: Someone stiff from a half-hearted workout wonders if they are getting in shape.
explanation.walkthrough: 'half-heartedly' removes one F from the central FF of STIFFENS, leaving STIFENS, which 'after exercising' rearranges.
explanation.definitionFit: Physical fitness, good bodily condition, is what someone working out is trying to achieve.
